messages:
kai: Starting a follow-up thread for yesterday's inter-region routing spike that caused TLS handshake retries and transient LB ejections. Need owners and short/long term actions.

anya: I dug into the proxy logs. We saw a burst of route updates from controller around 2026-05-08T03:22:xx leading to 90 rule pushes in ~90s. Key log: ```2026-05-08T03:22:12Z route-sync WARN apply: push timeout after 4s, retrying```

rashid: I'm happy to own a short-term mitigation at the proxy: debounce identical consecutive updates for 15s and expose proxy.debounce.suppressed_count metric. ETA 2026-05-14 for prod rollout (canary first).

kai: Please also add an alert: suppressed_count > 20 for 10m -> P2, and a dashboard panel by cluster.

rashid: added. ops-bot created INF-2260 "proxy debounce + LB retry policy" assigned rashid, anya. Link: https://issues.redwood/infract/INF-2260

anya: For LB behavior, proposal is to add 100-400ms jitter to TLS handshake retries and cap retries to 2 for inter-region backends. I'll run a 24h canary in eu-west-1. ETA 2026-05-12.

leo: Noting recurrence: found similar incidents in 2025-11 and 2026-01 during large config rollouts. I can correlate deploy windows and controller events for the postmortem doc by 2026-05-10.

kai: Good. Long-term: we need to fix controller reconciliation storms (probable cache race). Who can file a research ticket?

anya: I'll open a research ticket and gather traces (due 2026-05-20).

op-bot: Weekly follow-up scheduled 2026-05-11T15:00Z. Invitees: rashid,anya,leo,kai.

kai: Test harness: can someone create a flappy-controller test that does 60 route edits in 30s against staging and asserts handshake retry rate < 0.5%?

leo: I'll prototype the harness and post PR by 2026-05-09.

rashid: Deployed debounce to staging 2026-05-09T10:20Z. Staging smoke: suppressed_count rose to 64 under simulated churn and handshake retries dropped by ~80%.

kai: OK plan summary: rashid -> proxy debounce + metric + alert (due 05/14), anya -> LB retry jitter + canary (due 05/12), leo -> deploy correlation + test harness (due 05/09), anya -> research ticket for controller (due 05/20). We'll close when INF-2260 shows stable prod metrics for 72h. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
